result.rationale: Verified from the diff: refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw `fetch` Response when CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, but callers treat the return value with their original client's shape — zoho-bigin/zohocrm read `tokenInfo.data.error`, Google reads `res?.data`, hubspot SDK expects its token object. A fetch Response has none of these, so in sync mode these reads are undefined and broken/NaN credentials get persisted (e.g., `!undefined.error` is truthy in zoho paths).

judged_text: In credential-sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but several callers consume it with the shape of their original client (axios `.data`, google-auth `.res.data`, hubspot SDK token object), so every field they read is undefined. With CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, zoho-bigin/zohocrm read `tokenInfo.data` (undefined → `!undefined.error` is true, so garbage/undefined tokens get persisted), hubspot reads `hubspotRefreshToken.refresh_token`/`expires_in` (undefined → NaN expiry persisted), and calendar refresh silently writes broken credentials instead of falling back to the local refresh function.

With CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT set, zoho-bigin/zohocrm read `tokenInfo.data` (undefined → `!undefined.error` is true, so garbage/undefined tokens get persisted), hubspot reads `hubspotRefreshToken.refresh_token`/`expires_in` (undefined → NaN expiry persisted), and calendar refresh silently writes broken credentials instead of falling back to the local refresh function.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, the function returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response`. Multiple callers still treat the return value as their original client’s shape: e.g. Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data` (but `Response` has no `.data`), Hubspot assigns it to `HubspotToken` (but will receive `Response`), and Zoho Bigin/ZohoCRM access `tokenInfo.data.error` / `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` (will be `undefined` and/or throw). The diff shows no normalization/parsing step in `refreshOAuthTokens`, so enabling `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` will break these refresh flows at runtime.
